flags.observation: No style block or A/B variants accompany the candidate; groove, BPM range and genre rotation cannot be verified.
Punch "a much higher ceiling" leans on "P Two, Calvi", names normies cannot place; intro never says who speaks or what we are doing.
No artworkPrompt image words anywhere (cuckoo clock, walrus magnet, loan shark, Thames bridge); KayfabeTip 5 unused across all 28 cards.
Two colons in "Riksbank precedent: Federal Reserve Act:" at 108 characters; card name buried, not sayable in one breath.
Opener "Clock." repeats the card's own word; same echo at beats 21, 24, 27. No therefore/but bridge, no want or grudge.
Label openers "Hearings.", "Basel.", "Diplomats."; no "so", "except", "until" bridge in the whole song, so cards run as an and-then list.
Card's "merely" dropped; "congressional hearings paved way" loses the Kabuki claim that the hearings were staged.
"markets love regimes" drops the card's "totalitarian", emptying the claim; "BIS expert" compresses "founding member of the BIS expert commission".
Seven beats exceed 95 characters with opener: 3, 6, 15, 18, 21, 27, 30.
"rescue bankrupt, control infrastructure" recites the power as a telegraphic rule fragment; the card's Loan Shark identity is gone.
"coffers of elite families" drops the card's "a few", widening toward the family framing the deck note fences off.
"masking empire" drops the card's "corporate"; the satirical target shifts from corporate power to an unnamed empire.
Ferdinand Foch and "the cartel's" dropped; "next harvest predicted" leaves no one predicting and loses an expert dog whistle.
"Alps of pure morality" drops the card's "pretending"; the irony flips into a straight assertion.
Card's "Forcing" dropped; "war-torn nation sells mineral wealth" reads as voluntary, inverting the card's claim.
"no interest in policy" drops "dictated financial"; the government sounds indifferent rather than non-compliant. United Fruit reference lost.
"officially millions, blood-soaked history billions" flattens the card's 600 Million versus 600 Billion punch; opener "Immunity." duplicates the line's ending.
"missing IOR deposits and a witness" fuses lore and power; the witness reads as missing, and "before he could sing" is gone.
Two colons at 108 characters; "poisoned asset" tacked on as power fragment; "The Howard Hughes of Italy" dog whistle dropped.
